A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the capillary wave description of interfaces, which is exact in the case of 2d Isings, is not exact for other 2d models, but it can be used in a very simple way to predict universal results.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the first-order treatment is enough for the description of the universal properties of interfaces, which is in contrast to what happens for the description of bulk critical properties, for which the second-order treatment is required.
